references: User-provided Animarotta screenshots as visual direction; existing v271 artwork preserved for game pieces and backgrounds.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for an elaborate Japanese sweets-themed arcade medal game, with the decorative richness, glossy dimensional painted finish, whimsical candy colors and layered jewel-encrusted frames associated with Animarotta. This is original sweets imagery, no logos or copied characters.
Create EXACTLY SIX separate SQUARE ORNAMENTAL OPEN FRAMES arranged evenly in a precise THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid on a landscape 3:2 canvas. Each grid cell contains ONE isolated square picture frame, front view, identical size, fully inside its cell with a wide transparent gutter; no part touches another cell. Actual transparent RGBA background outside and INSIDE every frame. The center opening is empty and fully transparent, at least 68 percent of each frame's width and height. Decorations stay in the border and corners, never floating inside the opening. No scene behind them. No writing, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no badges with text.
Style: exceptionally polished hand-painted cartoon game UI art with rich small material details, sculpted/beveled golden trim, rounded layered rims, tiny engraved curls, dimensional confectionery, soft contact shadows confined to the object, bright multi-layer specular highlights, colored enamel and jewel accents. Whimsical, charming, richly illustrated, substantial and tactile; not photorealistic, not flat vector, not simple icons. Make the thin connecting rails usable for nine-slice stretching, with most distinct ornaments at the corners. Clean alpha edges. No opaque backing of any kind.
Frame order row-major, left to right:
TOP LEFT COOKIE: warm baked biscuit and honey-gold surround, delicately engraved cookie curls, piped ivory icing, tiny strawberry and pistachio accents, small amber gems.
TOP CENTER CHOCOLATE CANYON: deep chocolate sculpted ridges, creamy white ganache caps, copper and gold trim, faceted ruby and cocoa crystal corner ornaments.
TOP RIGHT SIX DROP: clear candy-glass rim with pink icing, ornate gold scrolls, jewel-like rainbow candy drops at the corners, translucent highlights and tiny sugar pearls. Precious candy display quality.
BOTTOM LEFT GELATO: layered pale aqua ice and pearl-white carved rim with gold trim, crystalline blue corner jewels, tiny snowflake relief and little colorful frozen-fruit details.
BOTTOM CENTER WINERY: purple enamel and golden vine scrolls, richly painted grape bunches and leaves at corners, clear crystal glints and ruby fruit accents.
BOTTOM RIGHT POPCORN: red-and-cream striped carnival enamel, ornate gold rim, clusters of fluffy ivory popcorn with buttery shaded creases and ruby/gold star corner fittings.
Balanced frame border thickness about 12–14 percent on each side. Render at high quality, landscape 1536x1024 or larger equivalent.
